children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 3, 2026) - Silver Pony Resources Corp.
(FSE: BJ40) (OTCID: PONIF)
(formerly Carlyle Commodities Corp.) ("
Silver Pony
" or the "
Company
") announces that it has approved the issuance of 1,150,000 stock options (each, an "
Option
") to an insider and founder of the Company for the purchase of up to 1,150,000 common shares in the capital of the Company (each, a "
Share
") pursuant to the Company's equity incentive plan (the "
Plan
"). Each Option vested immediately and is exercisable for a period of five (5) years at an exercise price of $0.20 per Share.

The Options were granted pursuant to the Plan, which was originally approved by shareholders at the Company's annual general meeting held on December 29, 2022. Under the policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange (the "
CSE

"), the Plan is required to be re-approved by shareholders every three years. Despite the Plan not being re-approved by shareholders in the last three years, the CSE has permitted the grant of the Options, provided that: (i) the grants are expressly subject to shareholder re-approval of the Plan and cannot be exercised unless and until such approval is obtained; and (ii) if shareholder approval is not obtained, the Options will automatically terminate and be cancelled without any further action or compensation. The Company intends to seek re-approval of the Plan at its next annual general meeting of shareholders.

All Shares issued upon exercise of the Options will be subject to a hold period of four months and one day from the date of grant in accordance with applicable securities legislation and the policies of the CSE.
Marketing Engagement
The Company has entered into an independent consulting agreement dated September 3rd, 2026, with Avec Creations Ltd. ("
Avec

"), pursuant to which Avec will produce, edit and disseminate video and CEO interviews via X and YouTube, as well as feature the Company's notable news releases in its newsletter. The services will commence September 3rd, 2026, for a term of three (3) months. In consideration for these services, the Company will pay the consultant a one-time fee of $20,000.00. Avec is an arm's length party to the Company and, to the knowledge of the Company, holds no securities of, and has no other interest, direct or indirect, in, the Company. All materials produced and disseminated under this engagement will disclose that they are issued by or on behalf of, and paid for by, the Company, in accordance with applicable securities legislation.
Avec Creations Ltd.'s contact information is as follows: 06551173 20-22 Wenlock Road, London, England, N1 7GU attention: Fabi Lara, phone: (351) 911 753 450, and email: fabi@thenextbigrush.com.

About Silver Pony Resources Corp.

The Company is an early-stage mineral resource exploration company engaged in the acquisition, exploration and evaluation of mineral properties. The Company's material property is the exploration stage Silver Pony Project, comprising 37 contiguous mineral tenures totaling 37,022.88 hectares in southeastern British Columbia, within the Slocan Mining District and Revelstoke Mining District.
